_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Leg is flat with no price breaker; base-rate coil favors HOLD at Complacency/Disbelief edge until range, F&G, or funding resolves.
next_move.brains_agree: partial split — analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency; narrative inflow print leans defensive/supply without a directional phase call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound, F&G mid-40s to low-60s, funding near zero
next_move.invalidated_if: range break with F&G >62 plus renewed ETF inflows (up) OR flush with F&G <40 and negative funding (down)
